**Coaching note:** When you have pieces attacking the enemy king (queen on g3, rook on g7, passed pawn on g2), look for forcing check sequences. Qh2+ wins because it eliminates the king's safety: either it falls into a mating net (Kg1 Qg2#) or it's driven forward where the bishop on e1 becomes indefensible. Always calculate one move ahead after forcing checks.
